items.label: UPGRADED DESIGN FEATURES
items.value: Wider 26 inch seat and thicker 5 inch cushion compared to industry standard 24 inch and 5 inch dimensions. Reinforced structure with hurricane-grade steel frame and thickened support beams. High-end aluminum with heat treatment wood grain coating for fashionable appearance and reduced metal heat in summer to protect skin. Top Olefin fabric that is easy to clean and maintains color for ten years without fading

items.label: EXTRAORDINARY COMFORT
items.value: Unique wider design allows adults to stretch their legs and children to play freely, eliminating the feeling of crowding. 105 degree tilted backrest with ergonomic design provides good support for the hips and back. Double-layer high resilience sponge prevents collapsing when sitting for extended periods, with wave-shaped decompression design for lasting comfort during outdoor gatherings

items.label: PREMIUM MATERIAL CONSTRUCTION
items.value: 3mm thickened aluminum provides strong support without deformation and is resistant to scratching, cracking and breaking. Top-quality Olefin fabric with UV resistant UPF51+ rating, stain-resistant and easy to clean with coffee and red wine wiping clean easily, maintaining color for ten years without fading

items.label: MULTIPLE SCENARIO USES
items.value: The patio sofa set is versatile and suitable for backyard, garden, patio, balcony, and poolside locations. Can be used as patio furniture or poolside furniture, providing diverse arrangement options for a variety of outdoor spaces and meeting the needs and preferences of different consumers

items.label: ASSEMBLY AND MAINTENANCE
items.value: The outdoor patio set provides detailed assembly instructions and accessory numbers for quick and easy installation. Offers 25-hour online customer service to ensure that user problems are solved in a timely manner

items.label: COMPLETE 7-PIECE SET
items.value: Includes oversized outdoor sectional seating for 7 people, coffee table, and waterproof cover. Washable thick cushions provide convenience and durability for long-term outdoor use in various weather conditions

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: High rebound sponge, Modular, durability, sectional, weather-resistant
